text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. If you were to go on a date 
with me, where would you take me?"
choice_data_list: A daaate!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, half of that was a joke. Some 
friends visiting from America are coming 
over, and I was wondering where to show 
them around.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, I know! Since we still have time, 
would you mind showing me around your 
favorite spots?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fiercely independent Daring Heart is 
uncharacteristically relying on me. I have 
to guide her properly and live up to her 
expectations...!
choice_data_list: Got it, leave it to me!
Got it, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm talking about! Let's get 
going!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remembering something I saw on TV before, 
I visited a dojo popular with foreign 
tourists.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! We get to sword fight! My friends 
are gonna love this!"
choice_data_list: Right on! That's a relief.
Right?! What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, since we're here anyway, why not give 
it a try and play a bit?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmmmm... This play-sword is a bit worn 
out, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If an Umamusume swings it, it might break. 
This doesn't seem safe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, the facilities are also 
deteriorating. Come to think of it, seeing 
it on TV was already years ago...
choice_data_list: Sorry, I didn't do enough research.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it! We just have to find 
another spot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to introduce a location that 
met expectations. However, there are other 
candidates.
choice_data_list:
(Next time, I'll make sure to satisfy 
her...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Japanese sweets, huh! Nice! We can all 
enjoy this together!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it's tasting time♪ Maybe I'll go 
with that manju!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, everything is so cheap. ...A 
closing-down sale?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. I'm closing down this 
shop today.
choice_data_list: What!? No way...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh…… I'm sorry to hear that. Even though 
it looks so delicious."
choice_data_list:
Sorry, this was a lack of research on my 
part...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, don't be down! It was just a 
string of bad luck."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Come on, keep your chin up! Just keep 
moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been relying on her support all day 
today. I feel like this is no different 
from how things usually are...
choice_data_list:
(Still, there are other candidates 
left...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Pickles, dried goods, and rice crackers! 
Now this really feels like Japan!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's wonderful getting to experience the 
culture at the same time. It's been a 
while since I last visited, but it's just 
as fascinating as always!
choice_data_list: Ah... So you knew...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There's an interesting shop next 
door... Oh! Found it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look, a shop with weird slogans on 
T-shirts! Why don't you try on the one 
with "Bancho" on it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't hesitate—whoever has fun wins! Think 
of it as a dry run for guiding people!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's been nothing but failures up to this 
point. ...If this can help me bounce back 
even a little!
choice_data_list: Okay. I'll try on the T-shirt!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so cooool! Please let me take a 
picture!
choice_data_list: Uh, um, sorry, sorry!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! Look at you, Miss Popular! It suits 
you well!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I'd love to show my friends back 
home. "Japanese Bancho," you know!
choice_data_list:
Maybe I should've bought a shinai too... 
Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! That was a good one!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll have to apologize to my friends 
later! For having fun ahead of them!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I laughed so much I'm exhausted! 
Why don't we take a break and have a bite 
of this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I bought some steamed buns from the 
Japanese sweet shop that's closing down, 
just for us♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle sweetness spreads through me. 
Introducing that Japanese sweets shop 
wasn't in vain after all... Wait, could it 
be—
choice_data_list:
These sweet buns... you were being 
considerate, weren't you?

These sweet buns... you were being 
considerate, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What? Ah, no way! I wouldn't go out of my 
way to do that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's the shop's specialty, right? Since 
we're here, we might as well give it a 
try.
choice_data_list:
I see... Things just aren't clicking 
today.

I see... Things just aren't going well 
today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You think so? I've been having a great 
time!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I make all the decisions, and you just go 
along with them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Our usual combination! Doesn't this just 
scream 'this is the one'?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Visiting all those places gave me great 
inspiration. It was the best date ever♪
choice_data_list: Next time, I'll escort you flawlessly!
I guess I really am no match for you.
I guess I really am no match for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Visiting all those places gave me great 
inspiration. It was the best date ever♪
choice_data_list: Next time, I'll escort you flawlessly!
I guess I really am no match for you.
I guess I really am no match for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, quite confident today, aren't we? 
Well then, I suppose I'll look forward to 
it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, if you show even the 
slightest opening, I'm going to surge 
right past you on my own!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as long as you hold onto that 
frustration, it will bear fruit one day.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you this as someone who 
watches you up close, so there's no 
mistaking it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Until that time comes, I'll be your 
escort!
